issue.title: Agents that poll a background just test-scoped skip /sase_final and force declaration recovery
issue.description:
## Bug

Agent `sase-s9.2` (run `20260823120149`) implemented its phase in full, then never
called `/sase_final`. It entered a poll/wait loop on a background `just test-scoped`
monitor and returned. Six consecutive "I'll wait for the background task" replies
appear in its `live_reply.md`. That skip is what made declaration-recovery necessary;
the recovery turn then refused the commit (fixed by this tale). The trigger remains:
agents that poll a background command instead of handing off through `/sase_monitor`
still skip the declaration and strand a held workspace.

Artifacts: `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202608/23/20260823120149/`.

This is not caused by epic sase-s9 (procs tab query filtering); it is a general
declaration-path failure mode discovered while that epic's phase ran.

task_type_fields.impact: Required declaration is missing; recovery may refuse; the workspace is held and the phase implementation can be reset.
task_type_fields.location: agent runner /sase_final skill; sase-s9.2 run 20260823120149 live_reply.md
task_type_fields.repro: Agent starts a background just test-scoped, then replies repeatedly with 'I'll wait for the background task' instead of /sase_monitor; the turn ends without /sase_final. See artifacts ace-run/202608/23/20260823120149/.
